d1.allocation_semantics: selected rows sharing a protected group must have one role; unselected accepted rows remain reserves
d1.content_conflicts: select at most one row from each non-singleton scene or human-similarity group and each duplicate normalized factual-caption group

hash_tiebreak.encoding: utf-8(base_policy_sha256 + NUL + D1 + NUL + role + NUL + source_id)

stratum.orientation: landscape when width>height; portrait when height>width; square otherwise

d2.acceptance_order: ascending HMAC-SHA256 row rank, then source_id; accept a row only when its protected identities are globally unused; stop at 76
d2.role_order: ascending HMAC-SHA256 role rank, then source_id; first 36 training and remaining 40 evaluation

purpose: make the frozen selection objectives executable without changing source candidates, review decisions, role counts, or admission state
